---
title: "Results, Provenance, and Packaging"
---

A benchmark that cannot be reviewed is a demo. MLPerf EDU treats the artifacts
of a run as first-class products, designed to be handed to an instructor, an
artifact evaluation committee, or a co-author.

## The Four Artifacts

Every workload run emits four files, named after the workload and profile:

| **Artifact** | **Role** |
|:---|:---|
| `*_report.json` | The complete result: metrics, environment fingerprint, asset dossiers, quality status |
| `*_report.html` | The same result rendered for humans |
| `*_report.csv` | Flat metrics for spreadsheets and plotting |
| `*.provd.json` | The provenance artifact: SHA-256 hashes of model state and assets |

The `.provd` artifact is the trust anchor. For training workloads it captures
the frozen model `state_dict` hash after the quality target is met; inference
workloads that consume a trained checkpoint verify against exactly that
artifact, closing the training-to-inference loop.

## Reading and Converting Reports

```bash
mlperf report submissions/nanogpt-train_max_report.json            # summary
mlperf report submissions/nanogpt-train_max_report.json --format html --open
mlperf report submissions/nanogpt-train_max_report.json --format csv
mlperf report submissions --format html --open                    # latest in a directory
```

Pointing `report` at a directory picks up the most recent run, which avoids
copying timestamped filenames.

## Verifying and Packaging a Submission

```bash
mlperf verify submissions/nanogpt-train_max.provd.json
mlperf package submissions/nanogpt-train_max.provd.json
```

`verify` re-checks the provenance manifest (hashes, fingerprints, quality
status). `package` bundles a verified result into a submission archive
suitable for grading or artifact evaluation.

## What the Fingerprint Buys You

Reports embed the hardware and software fingerprint of the machine that
produced them, including the Python, PyTorch, and platform versions and the
accelerator in use. Two results are comparable when their profiles match and
their fingerprints are disclosed side by side. When you publish a number from
MLPerf EDU, publish its fingerprint block with it.
